text:
anya (design): quick brain dump — compact spend grid is shipping but folks keep asking for a faster way to preview token breakouts without leaving the table. thinking: inline micro-preview anchored to the token cell (hover/focus) + an explicit "Preview" control for keyboard users.
mike (frontend): agree. implementation concerns: 400 rows = never render heavy DOM. plan: placeholder + progressive hydrate. only fetch details after 150ms hover or on focus. canvas sparklines to reduce repaint.
zara (pm): experiment idea: cohort A = hover/focus preview, cohort B = explicit control. measure: preview_open_rate, preview->invoice_click, backend_preview_qps. also track method in event payload.
kevin (data): event schema: `billing_preview` with fields: scope (org|project), method (hover|button|keyboard), row_type (project|endpoint), preview_loaded_ms, clicked_invoice (bool). will add to analytics board.
leo (a11y): accessibility checklist: previews must be reachable via tab. put a small `button.preview-toggle` in cell with `aria-controls` -> preview id and toggle `aria-expanded`. preview panel should have `role=region` and `aria-live=polite` for updates. for SR users, include hidden summary `#preview-summary-{id}` and `aria-describedby` from button.
anya (design): copy nits: header = "Token breakdown — past 30 days" (em dash), button label = "Preview". keep CTA in drawer: "View invoice" not in inline preview.
mike (frontend): keyboard flow: Tab -> Preview button (press Enter to open inline panel) -> Inner links (if any) tabbable -> Esc closes panel and returns focus to Preview. If we open full drawer, trap focus.
zara (pm): perf guardrails: client-side LRU cache per user TTL=4m, debounce hover->fetch 200ms, server-side rate-limit and batch endpoint for multiple row requests. feature-flag rollout only.
kevin (data): for cohort analysis add `preview_variant` to user profile. will compute conversion funnel: preview_open -> invoice_open -> invoice_download.
leo (a11y): reduced-motion preference must cancel pan/zoom animations. also ensure color contrast >= 4.5 for tiny numbers in preview.
anya (design): layout decisions: preview must not shift row height. use absolutely-positioned overlay anchored to cell or small popover. in org scope show top-3 projects by token %; in project scope show top-3 endpoints. micro-sparkline + 2-line text for each item.
mike (frontend): estimate: 3 dev days (preview-shell + lazy-load + analytics + flag). infra work for batching + throttles?
zara (pm): infra estimate?
kevin (data): infra: add batch preview API + per-user LRU cache -> ~1 day. also add `billing_preview` event pipeline.
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: staging smoke OK 2026-03-23T09:12Z
anya (design): one more tiny accessibility detail: announce when preview fails to load: `role=alert` with short message. and show retry affordance.
mike (frontend): good call. will show skeleton then `role=alert` if fetch error.
zara (pm): action items: anya update figma frames, mike opens feature branch behind flag, kevin wires analytics and infra folks add throttle. we'll run small-percentage rollout and check qps + a11y checklist before full rollout. target: next Thursday.
anya (design): thanks team! dropping updated frames and copy here in a bit :sparkles:
